title: 超键/候选键/主键的集合关系演示
expected_output:
=== 超键 / 候选键 / 主键 的集合关系 ===
R = ABC
F = AB->C, C->A

① 超键 (closure = R):
   AB     闭包=ABC <- 候选键
   BC     闭包=ABC <- 候选键
   ABC    闭包=ABC (含更小的超键, 非候选键)

② 候选键 (极小超键, 可能有多个):
   AB
   BC

③ 主键: 从候选键中人为选定 1 个 (实现层概念, 关系理论里不存在唯一的它)
   本模式若选 AB 作主键, 另一个候选键 BC 必须加 UNIQUE 约束

集合关系小结:
  候选键 ⊆ 超键          (2 ⊆ 3, 真子集)
  主键 ∈ 候选键          (选 1 个)
  主键 ⊆ 超键            (自动成立)
  非候选键的超键数 = 1

sqlite 中如何表达: 主键 = PRIMARY KEY, 其余候选键 = UNIQUE
  相同主键 (a1,b1)             -> 被拦截: UNIQUE constraint failed: t.a, t.b
  第二候选键冲突 (b1,c1)          -> 被拦截: UNIQUE constraint failed: t.b, t.c
code:
# 超键 / 候选键 / 主键 的集合关系演示
def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s))


print("=== 超键 / 候选键 / 主键 的集合关系 ===")
attrs = {"A", "B", "C"}
fds = [(frozenset("AB"), frozenset("C")), (frozenset("C"), frozenset("A"))]
print("R = " + fmt(attrs))
print("F = " + ", ".join("%s->%s" % (fmt(l), fmt(r)) for l, r in fds))
print()

lst = sorted(attrs)
n = len(lst)
supers = []
for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
    sub = frozenset(lst[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)
    if closure(sub, fds) == attrs:
        supers.append(sub)
supers = sorted(supers, key=lambda s: (len(s), fmt(s)))
cands = sorted([s for s in supers if not any(o < s for o in supers)],
               key=lambda s: (len(s), fmt(s)))

print("① 超键 (closure = R):")
for s in supers:
    print("   %-6s 闭包=%s %s" % (fmt(s), fmt(closure(s, fds)),
                                  "<- 候选键" if s in cands else "(含更小的超键, 非候选键)"))
print()
print("② 候选键 (极小超键, 可能有多个):")
for s in cands:
    print("   " + fmt(s))
print()
print("③ 主键: 从候选键中人为选定 1 个 (实现层概念, 关系理论里不存在唯一的它)")
print("   本模式若选 " + fmt(cands[0]) + " 作主键, 另一个候选键 " + fmt(cands[-1]) + " 必须加 UNIQUE 约束")
print()
print("集合关系小结:")
print("  候选键 ⊆ 超键          (%d ⊆ %d, 真子集)" % (len(cands), len(supers)))
print("  主键 ∈ 候选键          (选 1 个)")
print("  主键 ⊆ 超键            (自动成立)")
print("  非候选键的超键数 = %d" % (len(supers) - len(cands)))
print()

print("sqlite 中如何表达: 主键 = PRIMARY KEY, 其余候选键 = UNIQUE")
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE t (a TEXT, b TEXT, c TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (a, b), UNIQUE (b, c));
INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a1','b1','c1');
""")
for label, sql in (("相同主键 (a1,b1)", "INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a1','b1','c9')"),
                   ("第二候选键冲突 (b1,c1)", "INSERT INTO t VALUES ('a9','b1','c1')")):
    try:
        cur.execute(sql)
        print("  %-24s -> 未拦截(异常!)" % label)
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
        print("  %-24s -> 被拦截: %s" % (label, str(e)))
con.close()
